nodes.label: LTBridge
nodes.rationale: Python port of LTEngine --features api mode: a LibreTranslate-compatible REST server that proxies to an external OpenAI-compatible LLM with no local model loading; productionized successor of LTEngine-py.

nodes.label: OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint
nodes.rationale: Inference-server agnostic: only GET /v1/models and non-streaming POST /v1/chat/completions from an instruct-tuned model are required.

nodes.label: Instruct models only requirement
nodes.rationale: The prompt is a system+user pair expecting a plain translated reply; base/completion-only models and reasoning-only endpoints return no usable text.

nodes.label: Hybrid reasoning models (Qwen3.x, QwQ, DeepSeek-R1 distills)
nodes.norm_label: hybrid reasoning models (qwen3.x, qwq, deepseek-r1 distills)

nodes.label: chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking=false
nodes.rationale: Sent on every request; inherited from LTEngine and kept for byte-parity. vLLM/SGLang honour it, LM Studio ignores it.

nodes.label: --llm-reasoning-effort flag
nodes.rationale: Sends OpenAI reasoning_effort verbatim; 'none' disables thinking on LM Studio and recent vLLM. Empty means the field is omitted to preserve Rust byte-parity.

nodes.label: Grace-race fallback to untranslated source text
nodes.rationale: When an LLM call runs past --llm-timeout the response falls back to the untranslated source text with a 200 (implemented in server/streaming.py).
nodes.norm_label: grace-race fallback to untranslated source text

nodes.label: <think> block stripping
nodes.rationale: A leading terminated <think> block left inline is stripped; an unterminated one is a 500 rather than passing reasoning off as a translation.

nodes.label: Opt-in compat mode omitting enable_thinking (not built)
nodes.norm_label: opt-in compat mode omitting enable_thinking (not built)

nodes.label: Byte-parity port
nodes.rationale: Behavior is validated by diffing responses of the Rust reference binary and the Python server side by side.

nodes.label: Fail-fast startup model resolve
nodes.rationale: If --llm-model is omitted, the model is resolved from {llm-url}/v1/models before binding; exits with code 1 on failure, mirroring the Rust reference's startup behavior.

nodes.label: Embedding LTBridge in a host Litestar app
nodes.rationale: ltbridge.server re-exports a public embedding surface so a host app can mount the router, share its own pooled httpx.AsyncClient and reproduce byte-identical error bodies.
nodes.norm_label: embedding ltbridge in a host litestar app

nodes.label: boundary() outer ASGI layer
nodes.rationale: Required for parity, not polish: without it POST /translate/ returns 200 via Litestar slash-normalization instead of the pinned 405, GET / 404s instead of serving the bundled UI, and unknown paths get host-shaped JSON 404s. Records no metrics; serve_static=False drops the bundled UI.

nodes.label: Exact-path gate (API_PATHS | extra_api_paths)
nodes.rationale: Only exact matches reach the inner app; every host-owned route must be listed in extra_api_paths and trailing-slash variants are not implied.

nodes.label: --workers flag (Granian worker processes)
nodes.rationale: N>1 breaks /metrics because each worker has its own metrics registry; keep at 1 for any deployment that scrapes /metrics.

nodes.label: Dynamic token-budget cap (max_tokens)
nodes.rationale: Opt-in: active only when --llm-chars-per-token, --llm-max-tokens and --llm-max-tokens-mult are all > 0; floor for tiny inputs, ceiling wins over floor.

nodes.label: Pure-Python whatlang port
nodes.rationale: Replaced a vendored PyO3/maturin binding so the repo contains no Rust and uv sync needs no compiler.

nodes.label: Generated whatlang tables (_whatlang_data.py)
nodes.rationale: All tables are generated from the crate source, never hand-transcribed; the header records crate version, rustc version and SHA-256 of every parsed crate file.

nodes.label: Detection sweep zero-divergence gate
nodes.rationale: Replays 16 369 recorded oracle outputs covering every script, all 49 profiled languages, degenerate inputs and single characters.

nodes.label: Rust std case-table snapshot for lowercasing
nodes.rationale: rustc 1.96 ships Unicode 16.0 vs CPython 3.12's 15.0; pinning Rust's tables instead of str.lower() stops a future CPython Unicode bump from moving detection.
nodes.norm_label: rust std case-table snapshot for lowercasing

nodes.label: Stable sorted() vs Rust sort_unstable fidelity choice
nodes.rationale: Exact because Rust's sort_unstable is stable at the slice lengths involved.
nodes.norm_label: stable sorted() vs rust sort_unstable fidelity choice

nodes.label: WSL (Ubuntu-20.04) development workflow
nodes.rationale: The differential suite needs a native Rust toolchain and the Windows Rust/MSVC toolchain is broken on this dev environment, so Windows is edit-only.

nodes.label: run_suite.py one-command suite runner
nodes.rationale: Re-execs inside WSL from Windows, ensures the Rust oracle exists, and fails loudly on any skipped test because a skip means the oracle was missing or broken.

nodes.label: B1 gate summary (C=32 ratio re-anchored to 0.60)
nodes.rationale: Re-anchored 2026-08-15: the prior 0.70 bar was measured against a self-saturating in-process mock that inflated the ratio to 0.84-0.91; the honest out-of-process ratio is ~0.66. Note: bench/REPORT.md still documents the 0.70 bar.
nodes.norm_label: b1 gate summary (c=32 ratio re-anchored to 0.60)

nodes.label: B1 wrapper-overhead benchmark (mock upstream)
nodes.rationale: Final verdict PASS under the amended gate (3/3 runs, C=32 median RPS ratios 0.84-0.91).

nodes.label: B2 end-to-end sanity benchmark (real vLLM)
nodes.rationale: Not gated: model latency dominates; p50s track within ~5% between rust and py.

nodes.label: Amended B1 gate (C=1 p50 +3ms; C=32 median RPS ratio >= 0.70)
nodes.rationale: The C=32 p50 bar was unphysical: the mock saturates, floor-subtraction cancels algebraically, and 3ms sat below run-to-run instrument noise; median-of-runs RPS ratio is a lower-noise statistic. C=8 became informational.
nodes.norm_label: amended b1 gate (c=1 p50 +3ms; c=32 median rps ratio >= 0.70)

nodes.label: In-process mock upstream self-saturation
nodes.rationale: The in-thread mock shares the load generator's GIL/event loop and saturates around C=32 (~642rps/35ms with an empty body), measuring itself rather than the servers.

nodes.label: Double logging pipeline fix (logging_config=None, httpx at WARNING)
nodes.rationale: Litestar's default LoggingConfig made the app's basicConfig a silent no-op and routed every record (including httpx per-request INFO) through a cross-thread queue (~24% of profiled time). The only optimization with an unambiguous, reproducible, profiled effect.
nodes.norm_label: double logging pipeline fix (logging_config=none, httpx at warning)

nodes.label: --workers N benchmark optimization
nodes.rationale: actix-web defaults to one worker thread per core while Granian was hardcoded to one GIL-bound process; kept as correct in principle but its 'biggest lever' attribution was retracted because host noise is of the same magnitude.

nodes.label: Double JSON parse elimination (_has_type_mismatch / _field_type_mismatch)
nodes.rationale: A cheap isinstance pre-check skips the span-tracking re-parse unless a type mismatch exists; a single shared predicate keeps the fast and precise passes from drifting.

nodes.label: Confound 1: engine cold-start ordering
nodes.rationale: The first measured arm paid the shared engine's prefix-cache/CUDA warm-up cost; swapping arm order flipped the gap exactly.

nodes.label: Confound 2: prefix-cache contamination across arms
nodes.rationale: Reusing identical salted texts let the first arm warm vLLM's automatic prefix cache for the second; fixed by rebuilding bodies with fresh salts per arm.

nodes.label: --workers N>1 breaks /metrics
nodes.rationale: Each Granian worker is a separate process with its own CollectorRegistry built in create_app(), so scraped counters are not aggregated and not monotonic, breaking Prometheus rate() semantics.

nodes.label: Extended mock sweep (C up to 64, Rust-free tree)
nodes.rationale: Characterization only, not a gate; source is always explicit so the language-detection path is never exercised.
nodes.norm_label: extended mock sweep (c up to 64, rust-free tree)

nodes.label: Real-vLLM benchmark, dedicated engine box (authoritative)
nodes.rationale: On an unshared engine rust and py track within single digits at every C (worst C=4 at +5%), confirming contention drove the local C=4/C=8 divergence and round-to-round variance.

nodes.label: ABAB round ordering
nodes.rationale: Round 1 rust-first, round 2 py-first, reported as per-(arm,C) median so neither arm systematically pays a first-in-pair warm-up tax.
